next_step: Finalize KMS integration checklist + legal SOW review
notes:
- Priority: enterprise-grade private VPC deployment, finance use cases.
- Security pre-reqs called out on initial call: SSO (SAML), SCIM for provisioning, RBAC mapping to AD groups.
- CTO quote: "Must be in our VPC — no egress except approved subnets. Customer KM S required for all keys."
- Data residency: US-only for phase 1, EU reachability later. Sensitive PII/transaction metadata must never persist in hosted control plane logs; require audit log forwarding to Splunk.
- KMS: they require integration with their AWS KMS CMKs and HSM-backed keys for signing. Need key rotation policy alignment and proof that Redwood control plane does not store plaintext keys.
- Audit & compliance: full request/response audit logs retained for 13 months, tamper-evident audit trail, SAML assertion logging, SCIM provisioning audit entries.
- RBAC: mapping to AD groups, ability to restrict model access by role (generate vs embed vs admin). Must support read-only and admin console roles; need API tokens scoped to RBAC roles.
- Networking: VPC peering + private endpoints, egress lock-down. They want a maintenance window for peering changes.
- Quote from Dir. Sec Ops: "We will only run a POC with a control-plane contract + signed SOC2 addendum."
- Competitor concerns: they evaluated managed endpoints from Anthropic and OpenAI but flagged keys and provioning gaps. Redwood's private + KMS story is main differentiator.
- Commercial: target ARR 150-500k depending on ded. capacity and retention.
- Sales note: bring legal + infra leads into next call; share KMS integration spec and SAML/SCIM mapping template.
